facts.fact: Radio Dalsan reports Hormuud Telecom says its average customer pays about USD 0.50 for 1 GB of data plus 40 minutes of calls; an average per-gigabyte price, described as typical daily spend, not a monthly plan.
Radio Dalsan reports Somtel prices a 220 GB monthly prepaid bundle at USD 50 (about USD 0.23 per GB), stated as on its Somaliland network; a plan price. No date given, so the published date is used.
